name: discord
description: Discord bot: mention it and it replies through Elowen AI. Includes commands (/model, /display, /new, /help), per-channel model and display settings, live tool activity, different ways to deliver replies, status reactions and proactive notifications from cron/tick jobs. Server tools show information about servers, channels and members, search members, and manage roles, pinned messages, threads, channels, categories and messages. Discord roles control access, trusted-admin context and the room prompt. Account permissions come from the linked Elowen account.

configSchema.label: Connection
configSchema.hint: The bot token and the channels where it responds.

configSchema.label: Bot token
configSchema.hint: Discord Developer Portal → Bot → Token. Enable the Message Content intent.

configSchema.label: Guild ID
configSchema.hint: Optional: the bot only responds in this server. Leave empty to let it respond in every server it belongs to.

configSchema.label: Allowed threads
configSchema.hint: Thread IDs where the bot may respond. Empty = respond everywhere allowed.

configSchema.label: Notification destination
configSchema.hint: Channel or thread for proactive messages, such as cron/tick results and alerts. Leave empty to stop the bot from sending proactive messages.

configSchema.label: Replies & behavior
configSchema.hint: When and how the bot answers.

configSchema.label: Respond without mention
configSchema.hint: On: the bot answers every message in channels it can see (Iris-style). Off: it only answers when @mentioned.

configSchema.label: Tool activity
configSchema.hint: Choose what appears while the bot works: nothing, tool status, or part of its output. Change the channel setting with /display.

configSchema.label: Answer delivery

options.label: Show answer as it is written

configSchema.hint: Final answer sends one complete message below the live tool activity. Live updates the answer as it is written. Change the channel setting with /display.

configSchema.label: Tool output detail
configSchema.hint: Choose how much of the limited tool output appears below each status. The full original output is never sent to Discord.

configSchema.label: Tool message layout
configSchema.hint: One live message keeps the channel tidy. With one message per tool, each tool call has its own editable Discord message.

configSchema.label: Replace tool activity with the answer
configSchema.hint: Show one live progress message while the agent works, then replace that same message with the final answer. No message is deleted; live-answer and per-tool layouts are overridden.

configSchema.label: Processing reactions
configSchema.hint: Shows processing status using reactions on the incoming message.

configSchema.label: Runtime footer
configSchema.hint: Append a small "model · context %" line under the final reply.

configSchema.label: Show reasoning
configSchema.hint: Show the model's reasoning while it answers. Only available with extended-thinking models. Off by default.

configSchema.label: Service language
configSchema.hint: Language of the bot's own service messages (/new, /model, placeholders).

configSchema.label: Conversation
configSchema.hint: Context loading and image routing.

configSchema.label: Channel history backfill
configSchema.hint: How many recent channel messages a brand-new conversation loads as context (0 = off, up to 100). Ongoing conversations do not load the history again.

configSchema.label: Vision model
configSchema.hint: Model for messages with images. It must be able to recognize images. An empty field means the channel's usual model.

configSchema.label: Media limits
configSchema.hint: Limits for incoming and outgoing images, and how long a pending question stays open.

configSchema.label: Max inbound image size
configSchema.hint: Largest image attachment (in bytes) the bot downloads for recognition. Larger files are only noted.

configSchema.label: Max images per message
configSchema.hint: How many images from one message the bot sends to the model for recognition.

configSchema.label: Max file size (bytes)
configSchema.hint: Largest attachment other than images that the bot downloads to the sender's project. Larger files are only recorded.

configSchema.label: Max files per message
configSchema.hint: Number of attachments other than images stored in the sender's project from one message.

configSchema.label: Max images per reply
configSchema.hint: How many images shared by the agent the bot attaches to a single outgoing reply.

configSchema.label: Voice
configSchema.hint: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech (optional; reuses the voice provider's key).

configSchema.label: Voice provider
configSchema.hint: Choose a configured OpenAI-compatible provider for voice (Whisper STT + TTS). It uses that provider's key, so no separate key is needed. Add providers in Settings → Brain. Leave the field empty to turn voice off.

configSchema.label: Transcribe voice messages
configSchema.hint: Whisper transcribes incoming voice messages and audio attachments so the agent can understand them. You need an OpenAI API key.

configSchema.label: Speech-to-text model
configSchema.hint: Whisper transcription model (default: whisper-1).

configSchema.label: Speak replies (default)
configSchema.hint: Default for channels: attach an audio version of each reply. Turn it on or off per channel with /voice. You need an OpenAI API key.

configSchema.label: Text-to-speech model
configSchema.hint: TTS model (default: gpt-4o-mini-tts).

configSchema.label: TTS voice
configSchema.hint: Voice: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova or shimmer (default: alloy).

configSchema.label: Role policies
configSchema.hint: Assign Discord roles to access, trusted-admin context and a room-specific prompt.

configSchema.label: Role policies
configSchema.hint: The first matching role applies. Users without an assigned role are ignored. Enter a Discord role ID, or * for all members. Put the * rule after named rules, or it will override them. The `admin` role enables the shared /model, /reasoning and /context menus and the room commands /stop, /stats, /compact and /restart. The /restart command restarts the daemon for everyone. Projects and tool permissions come from the sender's linked Elowen account.
